findings.title: Evidence tree dominates the repository by file count and size
evidence: 816 of 1542 tracked files are under evidence/ (53%)
48.5 MB tracked total; several evidence exports exceed 2 MB
AGENTS.md rule 1: append-only evidence; never rewrite ledgers
findings.impact: Clone/fetch size and review noise grow monotonically; large generated exports under evidence/ add little review value.
findings.recommendation: Move multi-MB generated exports to Git LFS or an artifact store, keeping only the hash-pinned ledgers in-tree; keep the append-only rule for ledgers.
findings.note: Size is intentional append-only evidence; recorded as owner-accepted.

report: Inventory at 38b34a9: 1542 tracked files, 48.5 MB tracked, of which 816 files (53%) live under evidence/. Largest tracked blobs are OSV/repomix exports exceeding 2 MB each. The evidence tree is append-only by doctrine (AGENTS.md rule 1) and hash-pinned (evidence/MANIFEST.sha256), so its size is intentional; the finding is a maintainability/clone-cost note, not a defect.
